claim: A sector that should shut again after opening needs retrigger_a: on turning ON, SetSectorState posts an OFF after wait_time_a tenths of a second only when reTriggerA is set (and an ON after wait_time_b with reTriggerB). A wait time alone does nothing on a sector.
evidence: E1M1 s4 (614 sliding door): retrigger_a=1, wait_time_a=40.
use: For an auto-closing door set retrigger_a and wait_time_a together.
